<string name="pid_issuance_no_card_available_paragraph">A Digital ID can only be created using a national identity card or a residence permit. Travel documents such as passports cannot be used. Apply for a suitable ID at your citizen\'s office.</string>

<string name="pid_issuance_no_letter_forgot_pin_paragraph">If you can no longer find your PIN letter, or if you have forgotten your card PIN, you will need to visit your citizen\'s office to set a new 6-digit card PIN.</string>

<string name="pid_presentation_wallet_pin_last_entry_info_paragraph_1">You have one last attempt to enter the correct code before your ID is locked. After that, you\'ll need to add your ID again to create a new Wallet code.</string>
